turns.doctor_question: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response: Hi Dr. Smith. Well, student health actually sent me here. They told me they can't clear me for the youth workshops I'm supposed to do because they say my weight is too low. I guess the number has kept dropping, but honestly, to me it just feels like what happens when I’m really focused and busy with things.

symptom_reasoning.S044: The patient reports that student health told them their weight is too low and acknowledges that the number has kept dropping.
symptom_reasoning.S084: The patient dismisses the concern about their low weight, attributing it simply to being focused and busy, indicating a lack of recognition of its seriousness.

turns.doctor_question: Do you engage in any specific behaviors, such as self-induced vomiting, misusing laxatives, or excessive exercise, to influence your weight?
turns.patient_response: No, I don't do any of that. I've never made myself throw up, and I don't take laxatives or anything like that. And I don't really exercise all that much, either. I mean, I walk around campus to get to my classes, but I'm not spending hours at the gym. I just... I don't really do anything specific to lose weight, it just kind of happens when I'm running around all day and forget to eat.

symptom_reasoning.S047: The patient explicitly denies engaging in excessive exercise to influence their weight.
symptom_reasoning.S048: The patient explicitly denies making themselves throw up or taking laxatives.

turns.doctor_question: Do you ever feel like you lose control over your eating and consume an unusually large amount of food in a short period of time?
turns.patient_response: No, I don't think so. I don't really ever eat a lot at once. Honestly, it's usually the opposite. I just don't have the appetite or the time to sit down and eat a big meal. So, no, I wouldn't say I ever feel out of control like that.

symptom_reasoning.S049: The patient explicitly denies eating a large amount of food at once.
symptom_reasoning.S050: The patient explicitly denies ever feeling out of control regarding their eating.

turns.doctor_question: How do you feel about your current body weight and shape?
turns.patient_response: I mean... I guess I just tie a lot of how I feel about myself to how I look. Like, when I look at photos from the art showcase recently, I don't really even look at the artwork first. I just kind of... zoom in on my arms and my waist. And if I look small enough in the picture, I feel like I'm doing a good job. Like I'm serious and put-together. If I don't look small, I just feel wrong.

symptom_reasoning.S046: The patient explicitly states that their self-worth and feeling of being 'put-together' are tied to looking small in photos, indicating an undue influence of body weight and shape on self-evaluation.

turns.doctor_question: When you think about the concerns the student health center expressed regarding your weight, do you agree that your current weight is dangerously low?
turns.patient_response: I don't agree, no. I know people keep saying it's dangerous, but it really feels exaggerated to me. It's like they're making my body into this huge problem, but I'm just trying to stay sharp for school and my artwork. I don't see it as being dangerously low at all.

symptom_reasoning.S084: The patient explicitly states they do not agree their weight is dangerously low and feels the concerns are exaggerated, demonstrating a lack of recognition of the severity of their low weight.

turns.doctor_question: Could you describe for me what a typical day of eating looks like for you in terms of the amount and frequency of food you consume?
turns.patient_response:
I pretty much plan my whole day around not really eating. Um, I'll usually just have coffee before I head to the studio. Later on, if I'm at the café and people are around—like if I know they're watching me—I might have a few bites of something just so they don't ask questions. 

But I make sure to completely avoid bread or anything oily. Eating things like that... it just feels like it would undo all the control I've worked so hard for. So, overall, it's really just the coffee and maybe a couple of small bites of something safe throughout the whole day.

symptom_reasoning.S043: The patient explicitly describes severely restricting their food intake to just coffee and a few small bites, and actively avoiding specific foods like bread and oil to maintain control.

turns.doctor_question: Have you experienced any changes in your menstrual cycle since you began losing weight?
turns.patient_response: Um, I'm not really sure. I haven't really been paying attention to that, to be honest. I don't keep track of it, so... I haven't noticed anything specific.

turns.doctor_question: Could you tell me if it has been at least three months since your last menstrual period?
turns.patient_response: I mean... I really couldn't tell you for sure. Like I just said, I don't keep track of it at all. It might have been three months, or maybe it hasn't. I honestly just don't know.
